text: You want to exchange the water bottle and the desk lamp. You want to exchange the water bottle to a bigger one, and the desk lamp to a brighter one (prefer battery > USB > AC). If the agent asks for confirmation, only exchange the desk lamp.
zh: 您想换水壶和台灯。您想把水壶换成大一点的，把台灯换成亮一点的（优先电池 > USB > AC）。如果客服问是否确认，只换台灯。
